purpose: Raw material for the starting holding: the ground texture (a pro Wang tileset, raw and reduced to palette-28) and five props (the Writ post, the twisted tree, the stone outcrop, the holding store and Kesh's rock), each as every candidate, a numbered sheet, the pick and, where it fits its canvas, the pick placed by a whole-pixel move. ART cuts the shore pieces, cleans the props and rebuilds tiles-holding and the five prop-* recipes. No recipe, no art:build, no code, nothing retouched, recoloured or cut here.

repeat_check.note: mean colour step (0-255, per channel) across the wrap edge against between neighbouring columns/rows inside the tile
repeat_check.verdict: in the 6x4 patches (contact.png) neither reduced full tile shows a visible seam; wang_0 is near flat so its numbers are tiny; on wang_15 the wrap step is a little above the inside step because its grit specks and tufts are sparse and some sit near an edge, not because of a line

step1_ground.notes: As in tiles-cave, with transition_size 0 the border between the two terrains is drawn as a raised step with a 1 px dark rim and a lit top edge (the Wang tiles 1-14). The raw lower terrain is a lighter sand (median #E7D2A3) and the upper a darker tan (#CCAF87); after the reduction both bases become sleeper-soil, so the reduced set is one quiet floor whose variants differ only by grit, pebbles and tufts. The raw grit tones (#AB8F69, #B59973, #A28663, #947A5A, #866E52) all snap to unwritten-sail #8C7F6E, the skin-ramp colour, see colour_notes.

colour_notes.outline: Every pick outlines in dream-night #1C2147 (writ-post 242 px, twisted-tree 108, stone-outcrop 502, holding-store 439, kesh-rock 280), which the style sheet keeps for the player; props take hollow-deep #2A2540. The description asked for "a 1 px dark violet outline" and the palette snapped it to dream-night. Not recoloured here; ART's recipes map the outline by role.
colour_notes.skin_ramp: The twisted tree draws its dark wood in unwritten-tar #5E5448 (1025 px, the trunk's shade), the holding store its wood and cloth shade in unwritten-sail #8C7F6E (208) and unwritten-tar (147), the stone outcrop 13 px of unwritten-tar and 2 of unwritten-sail, the Writ post 5 px of unwritten-tar. Both are skin ramp only on player sheets, so ART's recipes map them (wood to the bronze/leather ramp, cloth to wheel-eye/husk-shell shades).
colour_notes.ground: The reduced ground uses 6 colours: sleeper-soil (the base of every tile), unwritten-sail (all the darker grit: the raw tones #AB8F69, #B59973, #A28663, #947A5A, #866E52 snap to it), sleeper-flesh (the lit rim of the raised step), wheel-eye (pebbles), wheel-patina (tufts) and watcher-iron (12 px, the tufts' shade). Unwritten-sail is the skin-ramp colour, so ART maps the grit (sleeper-flesh or sleeper-ochre are the brief's grit colours).
colour_notes.husk_core_and_green: No pick or candidate uses husk-core #FFF4C7, and the only green-ish colour anywhere is wheel-patina #2F7F7A (the tree's leaves, the ground's tufts).
colour_notes.reserved: No pixel in any file is #FFFFFF, #FFE7A3, #E0457B or #8E2550 (every create_image_pro result is on the 28-colour palette; the raw ground tiles are off-palette by nature and the reduced ones are on it).
